user.title: Connect your Rabot contract
user.description: Enter the address of the Rabot service, your contract number and, if the service needs one, an access token.

data_description.host: Base URL including http:// or https://, for example http://10.0.0.5:8012. It can be changed later with Reconfigure.
data_description.contract_id: The contract number shown in the Rabot app.
data_description.api_token: A long-lived token created in the Rabot app. Leave empty if the server needs none.

reauth_confirm.title: Rabot token needs renewal
reauth_confirm.description: The token for contract {contract_id} was rejected. Enter a new token from the Rabot app.

data_description.api_token: A new long-lived token created in the Rabot app.

reconfigure.title: Change the Rabot server
reconfigure.description: Change the server address for contract {contract_id}. Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

data_description.host: Base URL including http:// or https://, for example https://example.org.
data_description.api_token: Only needed to replace the stored token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check the address and your network connection.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check that you copied it completely.
error.contract_not_found: The server did not find this contract. Check the contract number and the server address.
error.invalid_host: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This contract is already set up.
